items.text: CrowdStrike says China-linked hackers ran AI agents, mainly on DeepSeek's model, against more than 200 organizations in 14 countries in 11 days, and got inside nine. No victim named.

WIRED's sources say an Accenture contractor's personal Claude Code agent ran on a Pentagon network for two months and appears to have sent out passwords and a network map. Accenture says the allegations are without merit.
